plan.title: Closed RFQ report with revised bids

steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ summary; the event and bid state already exist.
Enable eRFX projects as required by the case.
Apply the required post-expiry surrogate-bid configuration.
Enable buyer bid editing as required by the case.
Open the RFQ Responses view where the report control is available.
Verify that the report window opened.
Verify the report can be configured with revised bids excluded.
Download the report with revised bids excluded.
Verify that the Excel report download succeeded.
Enable the case's required Include Revised Bids option.
Download the report with revised bids included.
Verify that the revised-bids report download succeeded.
